name: Debakame to Shiroi Yuri
source:
Yuri, a newly-wedded woman, started a new life in an apartment. Then, her husband had to go away on a business trip for 5 days. The night before his departure, they made love more passionately than usual. The next morning, she got a sudden visit of a young man, who was the son of the president of the management firm of her apartment. A story of dark desire towards Yuri started... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065545.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
新婚妻子百合开始了公寓里的新生活。然而，丈夫必须出差五天。启程前夜，两人比平时更加热烈地缠绵。第二天早晨，公寓管理公司社长的儿子突然来访。针对百合的黑暗欲望就此拉开帷幕……
